title: CordLeacker
description: The plugin allows players or admins to quickly find out the coordinates of another player using a simple /cord command.
body:
📌 The plugin allows players and administrators to quickly check their own coordinates or another player’s coordinates using a simple /cord command.

🔧 Features:
📍 Displays current coordinates (X, Y, Z) and the world the player is in.
👥 Ability to view another player’s coordinates (if permissions allow).
✉️ Convenient in-chat message.
🔒 Configurable permissions for using the command.

⚙️ Commands:
/cord <player> – shows the specified player’s coordinates (requires permission).
Using CordLeacker

🔐 Permissions:
cordleacker.use – access to /cord <player>.

📜 Additional:
PlaceholderAPI support.
